name: GIRDER 格拉德 Aero Team press-fit T700/T800 Dura-Ace Di2
why_interesting: The hand-painted floral ROAD-section aero flagship: Dura-Ace Di2 R9270 on the earlier T700 + T800 press-fit frame with 60 mm wheels at an official ¥28,800, distinct from the T800 + T1000 NEW 2025 bikes.

facts.drivetrain: Shimano Dura-Ace Di2 R9270 2×12; FC-R9200 52-36T crank (length not listed), CS-R9200 11-34T cassette, CN-M9100 chain
facts.frame: ROAD-section AERO TEAM T700 carbon aero frame with T800 bottom-bracket reinforcement and T700 + T800 fork, 12 mm thru-axles, fully internal routing, hand-painted floral finish
facts.frame_material: T700 carbon frame with T800 bottom-bracket reinforcement; T700 + T800 fork; the page says Toray fiber; lay-up is not published
facts.frame_construction: EPS-molded aero frame and fork with internal routing and press-fit bottom bracket
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured or comparative stiffness evidence found; 'balance between strength and rigidity' is manufacturer copy
facts.bottom_bracket: Press-fit shell per manufacturer; the supplied in-house ceramic-bearing BB (19 G5 silicon-nitride balls) is described as 'PF386 Locking T47 Tool', so confirm the exact shell standard before ordering parts
facts.wheels: Adler Augen ('Eagle Eye') wavy-rim ceramic-bearing wheels, 60 mm front and rear
facts.tires: Maxxis M228 700C×28C skinwall folding tires with TPU tubes fitted; maximum clearance is not published
facts.cockpit: T700 integrated carbon handlebar, internal routing, 4° flare
facts.saddle: Selle Italia saddle and silicone bar tape
facts.sizes: S (476 mm), M (503 mm), L (533 mm); the size dimension is not labelled
facts.complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer-listed weight for this complete bike; size, pedals and weighing method are not stated
